changelog:
v5.2.3 — 4K on HD Fire TV Sticks

• On some HD Fire TV Sticks, like the Fire TV Stick Lite, 4K shows and movies now try to play on the stick's own video chip instead of being turned away. If the stick can't keep up, you'll see the same message as before after a few seconds, suggesting an HD version. After two failed tries, that stick goes back to showing the message right away. Dolby Vision titles still need a 4K device.

• The Stream Info panel now shows how much data the title you're watching needs, next to your connection speed, so it's easier to tell when a title needs a faster connection.
